name: Butter Chicken
steps: Season bite-size chicken pieces with salt, chili powder and half the garam masala, then brown them in butter and set aside.
In the same pan, cook chopped onion until golden, then add grated garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomato and simmer for 10 minutes until soft, then blend into a smooth sauce.
Return the sauce to the pan, stir in the cream and remaining garam masala, and add the chicken.
Simmer for 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Serve with rice or naan.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Heat oil and toast the cumin seeds for 30 seconds.
Add chopped onion and cook until golden, then add garlic and ginger.
Add chopped tomato and garam masala and cook until the tomato breaks down.
Stir in drained chickpeas with a splash of water and simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Season with salt and finish with chopped cilantro.

name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, cool it in cold water, then blend to a purée.
Toast the cumin in oil, then cook chopped onion, garlic and ginger until soft.
Add chopped tomato and cook until it breaks down.
Stir in the spinach purée and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cubed paneer and the cream, warm through, and season with salt.

name: Paneer Tikka
steps: Mix yogurt, grated garlic and ginger, garam masala, chili powder, lemon juice and salt.
Coat cubes of paneer, bell pepper and onion in the marinade and rest for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers, alternating paneer and vegetables.
Grill or bake at 220°C (425°F) for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.

name: Egg Curry
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, peel them and make a few shallow cuts in each.
Cook chopped onion in oil until golden, then add garlic and ginger.
Add turmeric, chili powder and chopped tomato, and cook until thick.
Add a cup of water and the garam masala, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the eggs and simmer for 5 more minutes so they absorb the sauce.

name: Chicken Parmesan
steps: Pound chicken breasts to an even thickness and season with salt and pepper.
Coat each in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with grated parmesan.
Pan-fry in oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden.
Top with tomato sauce and mozzarella, then bake at 200°C (400°F) for 10 to 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the cheese is bubbling.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente, saving a cup of pasta water.
Meanwhile, gently cook thinly sliced garlic in plenty of olive oil over low heat until pale golden.
Add chili flakes, then the drained pasta and a splash of pasta water.
Toss until glossy, then finish with chopped parsley.

name: Shrimp Scampi
steps: Cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Sear the shrimp in butter and oil for 1 to 2 minutes per side, then set aside.
Cook minced garlic briefly, add the white wine and let it reduce by half.
Add lemon juice, more butter, the shrimp and the pasta, then toss.
Finish with chopped parsley.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Brown sliced mushrooms in butter and set aside.
Cook chopped onion and garlic until soft, then stir in the rice for 1 minute.
Add the white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add hot broth one ladle at a time, stirring often, for about 18 minutes until the rice is creamy.
Stir in the mushrooms, a knob of butter and grated parmesan.

name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Slice the chicken into strips and toss with cumin, chili powder, garlic, lime juice and salt.
Sear the chicken in a very hot pan until cooked through, then set aside.
Cook sliced bell pepper and onion over high heat until charred but still crisp.
Return the chicken, toss together, and serve in warm tortillas.

name: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Cook diced onion in oil, then add drained black beans and cumin.
Mash lightly and season with salt and lime juice.
Mix diced tomato, cilantro and lime juice for a quick salsa.
Fill warm tortillas with the beans, sliced avocado and salsa.

name: Beef Burrito Bowl
steps: Cook the rice and stir in lime juice and salt.
Brown the ground beef with diced onion and cumin, breaking it up as it cooks.
Warm the black beans and corn.
Build bowls with rice, beef, beans, corn, diced tomato and grated cheese.

name: Pork Carnitas
steps: Cut the pork into large chunks and season with salt, cumin and oregano.
Place in a pot with quartered onion, smashed garlic, and the juice of the orange and lime.
Add water to half-cover, then simmer covered for 2.5 hours until very tender.
Shred the pork, then crisp it in a hot pan with some of the cooking fat.
Serve in warm corn tortillas.

name: Huevos Rancheros
steps: Simmer chopped tomato, onion and jalapeño until saucy, then season with salt.
Warm the black beans.
Lightly fry the tortillas until just crisp at the edges.
Fry the eggs, then layer tortilla, beans, egg and sauce. Top with avocado and cilantro.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
steps: Toss diced chicken with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Mix a sauce of soy sauce, rice vinegar, a little sugar and cornstarch with water.
Stir-fry dried chilies briefly in hot oil, then add the chicken and cook until done.
Add garlic, ginger and green onion, then pour in the sauce and toss until glossy.
Stir in the peanuts and serve with rice.

name: Mapo Tofu (Vegan)
steps: Cut the tofu into cubes and soak in hot salted water while you prepare the sauce.
Fry the chili bean paste in oil until the oil turns red, then add garlic and ginger.
Add a cup of water and the soy sauce, then gently add the drained tofu.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then thicken with cornstarch mixed with water.
Top with ground toasted Sichuan peppercorns and green onion.

name: Beef and Broccoli
steps: Thinly slice the beef against the grain and toss with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Steam or blanch the broccoli until bright green.
Sear the beef in a very hot pan in batches, then set aside.
Cook garlic and ginger, add oyster sauce, soy sauce and a splash of water, then return the beef and broccoli.
Toss until coated and serve over rice.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Use cold cooked rice, ideally a day old.
Scramble the eggs in hot oil and set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, diced carrot and peas for 2 minutes.
Add the rice and fry over high heat until hot and slightly crisp.
Add soy sauce, the eggs and green onion, then toss together.

name: Cauliflower Fried Rice with Shrimp
steps: Pulse the cauliflower in a food processor until it looks like rice.
Sear the shrimp until pink and set aside.
Scramble the eggs and set aside.
Stir-fry garlic and the cauliflower rice for 4 to 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce, the shrimp, eggs and green onion, then toss.

name: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
steps: Fry the green curry paste in a little coconut cream until fragrant.
Add sliced chicken and cook until it turns white.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk and add the eggplant and bell pepper.
Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice, then stir in the basil.

name: Pad Thai with Shrimp
steps: Soak the rice noodles in warm water until just pliable.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce and a little sugar for the sauce.
Stir-fry the shrimp, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss until the noodles are tender.
Add bean sprouts and green onion. Serve with crushed peanuts and lime.

name: Tofu Red Curry
steps: Press the tofu, cube it and pan-fry until golden. (Check the curry paste label: some contain shrimp paste.)
Fry the red curry paste in a little coconut cream until fragrant.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, bell pepper and zucchini, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the tofu, season with salt and lime juice, and stir in the basil.

name: Teriyaki Salmon
steps: Mix soy sauce, mirin, honey, grated garlic and ginger.
Sear the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip.
Pour in the sauce and simmer, spooning it over the fish, until thick and glossy.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.

name: Oyakodon (Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl)
steps: Simmer dashi, soy sauce and mirin with sliced onion for 3 minutes.
Add bite-size chicken pieces and cook for 5 to 6 minutes.
Pour lightly beaten eggs over the top, cover, and cook until just set.
Slide onto bowls of hot rice.

name: Miso Soup with Tofu
steps: Soak the kombu in 4 cups of water for 10 minutes, then heat until just below a boil and remove it.
Rehydrate the wakame in water and drain.
Add cubed tofu and the wakame to the broth.
Turn off the heat and whisk in the miso paste (don't boil it). Top with green onion.

name: Greek Chicken Souvlaki
steps: Marinate chicken cubes in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano and salt for at least 20 minutes.
Make tzatziki: mix yogurt with grated, squeezed cucumber, garlic and lemon.
Thread the chicken onto skewers and grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Serve with tzatziki, sliced tomato and red onion.

name: Falafel Bowl
steps: Pulse drained chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin and coriander until coarse.
Mix in a few spoonfuls of flour so the mixture holds together, then form small patties.
Pan-fry in oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Thin the tahini with lemon juice and water to make a sauce.
Serve the falafel with chopped cucumber and tomato, drizzled with tahini sauce.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Cook chopped onion and bell pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomato and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until thick, then season.
Make small wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until the whites are set.

name: Lemon Herb Baked Fish
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Place the fish in a baking dish with halved cherry tomatoes and olives.
Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice and minced garlic, then season.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the fish flakes easily. Top with parsley.

name: Classic Beef Burger
steps: Divide the beef into 4 patties, slightly wider than the buns, and season well.
Cook on a hot grill or pan for 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Add cheese in the last minute and cover to melt.
Toast the buns, then build with lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.

name: Garlic Butter Steak
steps: Pat the steak dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
Sear in a very hot pan for 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Add butter, smashed garlic, rosemary and thyme, and baste the steak for 1 minute.
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

name: BBQ Pulled Pork
steps: Rub the pork with brown sugar, paprika and salt.
Place on a bed of sliced onion and garlic in a covered pot, and add a splash of vinegar.
Cook at 150°C (300°F) for about 4 hours until it shreds easily.
Shred the meat and mix with BBQ sauce and some of the juices.

name: Mac and Cheese
steps: Cook the macaroni until just al dente.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk and simmer until thickened.
Off the heat, stir in grated cheddar and mustard until smooth.
Mix with the macaroni and season to taste.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate chicken pieces in yogurt, half the garam masala, cumin, paprika and salt for at least 20 minutes.
Grill or broil the chicken until charred at the edges.
Cook chopped onion until golden, then add garlic, ginger and the remaining spices.
Add chopped tomato and simmer for 10 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream and chicken and simmer for 10 minutes.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Rinse the lentils and simmer with turmeric and 3 cups of water for 20 minutes until soft.
In a separate pan, fry cumin seeds and dried chilies in oil until fragrant.
Add sliced garlic and chopped onion and cook until golden, then add chopped tomato until soft.
Pour this tadka over the lentils, season with salt and top with cilantro.

name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Toast cumin seeds in oil, then cook chopped onion until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric and chopped tomato and cook for 3 minutes.
Add cubed potatoes and cauliflower florets with a splash of water and salt.
Cover and cook on low for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring gently, until tender.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Rajma (Kidney Bean Curry)
steps: Toast cumin in oil, then cook chopped onion until deep golden.
Add garlic, ginger, chili powder and garam masala.
Add puréed tomato and cook until the oil separates.
Add the kidney beans and 2 cups of water and simmer for 20 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken.

name: Lamb Rogan Josh
steps: Brown the lamb pieces in oil in batches and set aside.
Fry cardamom and bay leaves briefly, then cook sliced onion until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, chili powder and garam masala.
Return the lamb and stir in the yogurt a spoonful at a time.
Add a cup of water, cover and simmer for 60 to 75 minutes until the lamb is tender.

name: Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, garlic, ginger, garam masala and salt for 30 minutes.
Fry thinly sliced onion until crisp and brown, then set aside.
Cook the marinated chicken in the onion pan for 10 minutes.
Boil the rice in salted water until about 70% cooked, then drain.
Layer the rice over the chicken with fried onion, mint and saffron soaked in warm water. Cover tightly and cook on low for 25 minutes.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Cook chopped onion, tomato and cashews in butter until soft, then blend until smooth.
Return to the pan with garlic, ginger and garam masala and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cream and season with salt.
Add cubed paneer and simmer for 5 minutes.

name: Goan Fish Curry
steps: Cook sliced onion until soft, then add garlic, ginger, turmeric and chili powder.
Add chopped tomato and cook until soft.
Pour in the coconut milk and tamarind paste and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add chunks of fish and simmer gently for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti until al dente, saving a cup of pasta water.
Crisp diced pancetta in a pan, then turn off the heat.
Whisk eggs with grated parmesan and plenty of black pepper.
Toss the hot pasta with the pancetta, then quickly stir in the egg mixture off the heat, adding pasta water until creamy.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Cook finely chopped onion, carrot and celery until soft, then add garlic.
Add the beef and brown it, breaking it up.
Pour in the red wine and let it bubble for 2 minutes.
Add chopped tomato, season and simmer for 40 minutes.
Serve over cooked spaghetti.

name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Heat the oven as hot as it goes, ideally 250°C (480°F), with a tray inside.
Stretch the dough into a thin round.
Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce and add torn mozzarella.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until blistered, then top with basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Pasta Primavera
steps: Cook the penne until al dente.
Sauté sliced zucchini and bell pepper until just tender, then add garlic.
Add halved cherry tomatoes and peas and cook for 2 minutes.
Toss with the pasta, a splash of pasta water and grated parmesan.

name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomato and mozzarella.
Arrange them alternately on a plate with basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then season with salt and pepper.

name: Minestrone
steps: Cook chopped onion, carrot and celery in olive oil until soft, then add garlic.
Add diced zucchini, chopped tomato and the broth and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the beans and pasta and cook until the pasta is tender.
Season and serve with a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Pesto Pasta with Chicken
steps: Blend basil, pine nuts, garlic, parmesan and olive oil into a pesto.
Cook the penne until al dente.
Season and pan-fry the chicken until cooked, then slice.
Toss the pasta with pesto, a little pasta water and the chicken.

name: Eggplant Parmigiana
steps: Slice the eggplant, brush with olive oil and roast at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes.
Layer eggplant, tomato sauce, basil, mozzarella and parmesan in a baking dish.
Repeat the layers, finishing with cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes until bubbling and golden.

name: Chicken Piccata
steps: Pound the chicken thin, season and dust with flour.
Pan-fry in oil and a little butter until golden and cooked, then set aside.
Add white wine, lemon juice and capers to the pan and reduce by half.
Swirl in butter, return the chicken, and finish with parsley.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Mix shredded cooked chicken with chopped onion and half the cheese.
Warm the tortillas, fill each with chicken and roll up.
Place seam-side down in a dish and cover with enchilada sauce and the rest of the cheese.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 20 minutes, then top with cilantro.

name: Guacamole
steps: Mash the avocados with lime juice and salt.
Stir in finely chopped onion, tomato, jalapeño and cilantro.
Taste and add more lime or salt as needed.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Cook onion, garlic and jalapeño until soft, then add cumin.
Add chopped tomato, the broth and the chicken and simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove and shred the chicken, then return it to the pot.
Bake or fry tortilla strips until crisp.
Serve the soup with tortilla strips, avocado and lime.

name: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the beef with chopped onion.
Add cumin, chili powder, salt and a splash of water, and simmer until thick.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef and top with lettuce, tomato and cheese.

name: Shrimp Tacos
steps: Toss the shrimp with chili powder, salt and lime juice.
Toss shredded cabbage with lime juice and cilantro.
Sear the shrimp for 1 to 2 minutes per side.
Serve in warm tortillas with the slaw and sliced avocado.

name: Vegetable Quesadillas
steps: Sauté sliced bell pepper, onion and mushrooms with the corn until soft.
Spread the filling and cheese over half of each tortilla and fold.
Cook in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and melted.
Cut into wedges.

name: Mexican Red Rice
steps: Blend tomato, onion and garlic until smooth.
Fry the rice in oil until lightly golden.
Add the tomato purée and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the broth and salt, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes, then rest for 5.

name: Pozole Rojo
steps: Simmer the pork with onion, garlic and salt in plenty of water for 2 hours.
Soak the dried chilies in hot water, then blend with some soaking liquid and garlic.
Strain the chili sauce into the pot and add the hominy and oregano.
Simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with shredded cabbage, sliced radish and lime.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork
steps: Toss pork pieces in soy sauce and cornstarch, then fry until crisp.
Mix ketchup, rice vinegar, sugar and a splash of water for the sauce.
Stir-fry bell pepper, onion and pineapple for 2 minutes.
Add the sauce, thicken with a little cornstarch slurry, and toss in the pork.

name: General Tso's Chicken
steps: Coat chicken pieces in cornstarch and fry until golden and crisp.
Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, sugar and water.
Fry dried chilies, garlic and ginger briefly.
Add the sauce, let it thicken, then toss in the chicken and green onion.

name: Vegetable Lo Mein
steps: Cook the noodles, drain and toss with sesame oil.
Stir-fry garlic, then the sliced vegetables over high heat for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles and soy sauce and toss until coated.
Finish with green onion.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Bring the broth to a simmer with sliced mushrooms and bamboo shoots.
Add strips of tofu, soy sauce, rice vinegar and plenty of white or black pepper.
Thicken with cornstarch mixed with water.
Slowly drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring, then top with green onion.

name: Steamed Fish with Ginger and Scallion
steps: Place the fish on a plate and top with half the ginger, cut into thin strips.
Steam for 8 to 10 minutes until it flakes.
Top with the remaining ginger and green onion.
Pour sizzling hot oil over the top, then drizzle with soy sauce.

name: Char Siu (Chinese BBQ Pork)
steps: Mix hoisin sauce, soy sauce, honey, garlic and five spice.
Marinate strips of pork in half the mixture for at least 2 hours.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) on a rack for 25 minutes.
Brush with the remaining sauce and roast for 10 to 15 minutes more until sticky and charred.

name: Garlic Bok Choy
steps: Halve the bok choy lengthways and rinse well.
Fry sliced garlic in hot oil until fragrant.
Add the bok choy and a splash of water and stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce.

name: Dan Dan Noodles
steps: Fry the pork until crisp, then add a splash of soy sauce.
Mix sesame paste, chili oil, soy sauce, garlic and ground Sichuan peppercorns in the serving bowls.
Cook the noodles and blanch the bok choy.
Add the noodles to the bowls, top with pork, bok choy and green onion, and toss.

name: Tom Yum Soup with Shrimp
steps: Simmer bruised lemongrass, sliced galangal and torn lime leaves in 4 cups of water for 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and crushed chilies and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until just pink.
Turn off the heat and season with fish sauce and lime juice.

name: Tom Kha Gai
steps: Simmer coconut milk with lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves for 5 minutes.
Add sliced chicken and mushrooms and simmer until cooked.
Season with fish sauce, lime juice and a pinch of sugar.

name: Massaman Beef Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in a little coconut cream until fragrant.
Add cubed beef and stir to coat.
Add the rest of the coconut milk and simmer covered for 1 hour.
Add potatoes, onion and peanuts and cook for 30 minutes more.
Season with fish sauce, tamarind and a little sugar.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow)
steps: Pound garlic and chilies together.
Stir-fry them briefly, then add the chicken and cook through.
Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce and a pinch of sugar.
Stir in the basil until wilted.
Serve over rice with a crispy fried egg.

name: Green Papaya Salad (Som Tam)
steps: Shred the green papaya into thin strips.
Pound garlic and chilies in a mortar.
Add green beans and tomatoes and bruise lightly.
Add fish sauce, lime juice, sugar and the papaya, and pound and toss to combine.
Top with peanuts.

name: Panang Pork Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in thick coconut cream until fragrant.
Add thinly sliced pork and cook until no longer pink.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, lime leaves and bell pepper and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil.

name: Thai Peanut Noodles with Tofu
steps: Pan-fry cubed tofu until golden.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, garlic and warm water into a sauce.
Cook the noodles and drain.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, tofu, shredded carrot and green onion.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
steps: Soak the sticky rice for at least 4 hours, then steam for 20 to 25 minutes.
Warm the coconut milk with sugar and a pinch of salt.
Stir most of the coconut milk into the hot rice and let it rest for 15 minutes.
Serve with sliced mango and the remaining coconut milk spooned over.

name: Pad See Ew with Chicken
steps: Stir-fry garlic and sliced chicken until cooked.
Add chopped Chinese broccoli and cook for 1 minute.
Push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce and a pinch of sugar, and toss over high heat until lightly charred.

name: Chicken Katsu
steps: Pound the chicken to an even thickness and season.
Coat in flour, then beaten egg, then panko.
Fry in oil for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Slice and serve with shredded cabbage and tonkatsu sauce.

name: Beef Sukiyaki
steps: Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar for the sauce.
Briefly sear thinly sliced beef in a shallow pot.
Add the sauce, then arrange the tofu, cabbage, mushrooms and green onion around the beef.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender.

name: Chicken Yakitori
steps: Simmer soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar until slightly thick.
Thread chicken pieces and green onion onto skewers.
Grill, turning, until nearly cooked.
Brush with the sauce and grill for 1 to 2 minutes more, repeating once or twice.

name: Vegetable Tempura
steps: Slice the vegetables thinly.
Stir flour and cornstarch into ice-cold sparkling water until just mixed; lumps are fine.
Dip the vegetables in batter and fry at 180°C (350°F) in small batches until crisp.
Drain and serve immediately with salt or dipping sauce.

name: Japanese Chicken Curry
steps: Brown the chicken pieces, then add sliced onion and cook until soft.
Add chunks of carrot and potato and enough water to cover.
Simmer for 20 minutes until tender.
Turn off the heat, stir in the curry roux until dissolved, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve over rice.

name: Yaki Udon with Shrimp
steps: Loosen the udon noodles in hot water and drain.
Stir-fry the shrimp until pink, then set aside.
Stir-fry the onion, cabbage and carrot until just tender.
Add the noodles, shrimp, soy sauce and mirin, and toss until hot.

name: Tamagoyaki (Rolled Omelette)
steps: Beat the eggs with soy sauce, mirin and a pinch of sugar.
Pour a thin layer into an oiled pan and roll it up once it's nearly set.
Push the roll to one side, add another thin layer, and roll again.
Repeat until the egg is used up, then slice.

name: Agedashi Tofu
steps: Drain the tofu well and cut into cubes.
Simmer dashi, soy sauce and mirin to make the broth.
Coat the tofu in cornstarch and fry until crisp.
Serve in the broth topped with grated daikon and green onion.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod
steps: Mix miso paste, mirin, sake and sugar into a smooth glaze.
Coat the cod and marinate for at least 1 hour, or overnight.
Wipe off excess glaze and broil for 8 to 10 minutes until caramelized and flaky.

name: Hummus
steps: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt.
Add ice water a spoonful at a time while blending until very smooth.
Serve with a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Greek Salad
steps: Cut the tomato, cucumber and bell pepper into chunks and slice the red onion.
Add the olives and toss with olive oil, salt and a splash of vinegar.
Top with a slab of feta and a sprinkle of oregano.

name: Lamb Kofta
steps: Mix the lamb with grated onion, garlic, parsley, spices and salt.
Shape around skewers into long kebabs.
Grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until cooked through.

name: Tabbouleh
steps: Soak the bulgur in hot water for 15 minutes, then drain well.
Finely chop plenty of parsley and mint.
Mix with diced tomato, cucumber and green onion.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil and salt.

name: Spanakopita
steps: Cook chopped onion, then add spinach until wilted and squeeze out the liquid.
Mix with crumbled feta, beaten eggs and dill.
Layer half the phyllo in a dish, brushing each sheet with melted butter.
Spread the filling, then top with the remaining buttered phyllo.
Score the top and bake at 180°C (350°F) for 40 minutes until golden.

name: Moussaka
steps: Slice the eggplant and potatoes, brush with oil and roast until soft.
Brown the lamb with onion and garlic, then add tomato and cinnamon and simmer for 20 minutes.
Make a white sauce: cook butter and flour, whisk in milk until thick, then add parmesan.
Layer potatoes, eggplant and lamb in a dish, then pour the sauce over the top.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 45 minutes and rest before cutting.

name: Red Lentil Soup
steps: Cook chopped onion and carrot in olive oil until soft, then add garlic, cumin and paprika.
Add the lentils and broth and simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Season and serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Greek Garlic Lemon Shrimp
steps: Toss the shrimp with olive oil, garlic, oregano and salt.
Sear in a hot pan for 1 to 2 minutes per side.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley.

name: Chicken Shawarma
steps: Mix yogurt, garlic, lemon juice and spices.
Marinate the chicken for at least 1 hour.
Roast at 220°C (425°F) for 25 to 30 minutes until charred at the edges.
Slice thinly and serve with salad, rice or flatbread.

name: Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar and salt.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Cook ladlefuls on a buttered pan until bubbles form, then flip and cook until golden.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Place cheese between the slices, buttered sides out.
Cook on medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and melted.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Cook onion, carrot and celery in butter until soft.
Stir in the flour, then gradually add the broth and milk and simmer until thick.
Add cooked chicken and peas, then season.
Pour into a dish, cover with the crust and cut a few slits.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 30 minutes until golden.

name: Cobb Salad
steps: Cook the chicken and bacon, then chop.
Hard-boil the eggs and chop.
Arrange rows of chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese over the lettuce.
Dress with a simple vinaigrette.

name: Classic Meatloaf
steps: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, chopped onion, milk, Worcestershire and salt.
Shape into a loaf on a lined tray.
Spread ketchup over the top.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 55 to 60 minutes, then rest for 10 minutes.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wings
steps: Pat the wings dry and season with salt.
Bake on a rack at 220°C (425°F) for 40 to 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Melt the butter with hot sauce and garlic.
Toss the wings in the sauce.

name: Shrimp and Grits
steps: Cook the grits according to the package, then stir in butter and cheddar.
Crisp chopped bacon, then cook the shrimp and garlic in the fat until pink.
Add lemon juice and green onion.
Spoon the shrimp over the grits.

name: Three-Bean Chili
steps: Cook chopped onion and bell pepper until soft, then add garlic, chili powder and cumin.
Add chopped tomato and all the beans.
Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Season to taste.

name: Blackened Catfish
steps: Coat the fish generously in Cajun seasoning.
Heat a cast-iron pan until very hot and add butter.
Cook the fish for 2 to 3 minutes per side until blackened and flaky.
Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Bibimbap
steps: Marinate thinly sliced beef in soy sauce, garlic and sesame oil, then stir-fry.
Separately cook the spinach, carrot, bean sprouts and mushrooms, seasoning each with sesame oil and salt.
Fry the eggs sunny side up.
Arrange everything over bowls of rice and serve with gochujang to mix in.

name: Beef Bulgogi
steps: Blend the pear, garlic, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Marinate thinly sliced beef for at least 30 minutes.
Cook in a very hot pan in batches until caramelized.
Top with green onion and sesame seeds.

name: Kimchi Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry chopped onion and kimchi for 3 minutes.
Add cold cooked rice, gochujang and a splash of kimchi juice and fry until hot.
Finish with sesame oil.
Top with fried eggs and green onion.

name: Korean Fried Chicken
steps: Coat the chicken in a mix of cornstarch, flour and salt.
Fry at 170°C (340°F) for 10 minutes, rest, then fry again at 190°C (375°F) until very crisp.
Simmer gochujang, soy sauce, honey, garlic and ginger until glossy.
Toss the chicken in the sauce.

name: Japchae
steps: Cook the noodles, drain and toss with sesame oil and soy sauce.
Stir-fry the beef with garlic and soy sauce.
Stir-fry each vegetable briefly, and blanch the spinach.
Toss everything together with more soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.

name: Sundubu Jjigae (Soft Tofu Stew)
steps: Fry gochugaru and garlic in oil to make a chili oil.
Add onion, zucchini and kimchi and stir-fry briefly.
Add 2 cups of water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add big spoonfuls of soft tofu and simmer for 3 minutes.
Crack in an egg just before serving.

name: Kimchi Jjigae
steps: Fry the sliced pork belly until the fat renders.
Add kimchi, onion, garlic and gochugaru and cook for 5 minutes.
Add water and kimchi juice and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add sliced tofu and green onion and simmer for 5 minutes more.

name: Dakgalbi (Spicy Chicken Stir-Fry)
steps: Mix gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, garlic and sugar.
Marinate the chicken in half the sauce.
Stir-fry the chicken with sweet potato, onion and cabbage.
Add the remaining sauce and cook until the chicken is done and the sweet potato is soft.

name: Gyeran Mari (Korean Rolled Omelette)
steps: Beat the eggs with finely chopped carrot, green onion and salt.
Pour a thin layer into an oiled pan.
Roll up when nearly set, push aside, and add another layer.
Repeat, then rest briefly and slice.

name: Haemul Pajeon (Seafood Scallion Pancake)
steps: Mix flour, cold water and salt into a thin batter.
Lay green onion in an oiled pan, scatter with chopped shrimp, and pour over the batter.
Drizzle beaten egg on top and cook until crisp underneath, then flip.
Serve with soy sauce mixed with rice vinegar.

name: Tteokbokki (Spicy Rice Cakes)
steps: Soak hard rice cakes in warm water for 10 minutes.
Bring 2 cups of water to a boil with gochujang, gochugaru and sugar.
Add the rice cakes and cabbage and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Top with green onion.

name: Jeyuk Bokkeum (Spicy Pork Stir-Fry)
steps: Mix gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, garlic, ginger and sugar.
Coat thinly sliced pork in the sauce.
Stir-fry with sliced onion over high heat until the pork is cooked and caramelized.
Add green onion and serve with rice.

name: Pho Bo (Beef Noodle Soup)
steps: Char the onion and ginger, and toast the star anise and cinnamon.
Simmer the beef bones with the aromatics in plenty of water for at least 2.5 hours, then strain.
Season the broth with fish sauce and a little sugar.
Place cooked noodles and paper-thin raw sirloin in bowls and ladle the boiling broth over.
Serve with bean sprouts, basil and lime.

name: Pho Ga (Chicken Noodle Soup)
steps: Char the onion and ginger, and toast the star anise and coriander seeds.
Simmer the chicken with the aromatics in water for 45 minutes.
Remove and shred the chicken, then strain the broth and season with fish sauce.
Serve over noodles with the chicken, bean sprouts, cilantro and lime.

name: Banh Mi with Lemongrass Pork
steps: Pickle shredded carrot and daikon in rice vinegar, sugar and salt for 20 minutes.
Marinate thin slices of pork in fish sauce, garlic and sugar, then cook until caramelized.
Split and toast the baguette and spread with mayonnaise.
Fill with pork, pickles, cucumber, jalapeño and cilantro.

name: Fresh Spring Rolls with Shrimp (Goi Cuon)
steps: Cook the shrimp and halve them lengthways, and cook the vermicelli.
Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water until soft.
Layer lettuce, noodles, cucumber, mint and shrimp, then roll up tightly.
Mix fish sauce, lime juice, sugar and water for dipping.

name: Bun Cha (Grilled Pork with Noodles)
steps: Mix the pork with shallots, garlic, fish sauce and sugar and shape into small patties.
Grill until charred and cooked through.
Make a dipping broth from fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, garlic and warm water.
Serve the patties in the broth with noodles, lettuce, mint and cucumber.

name: Lemongrass Chicken
steps: Finely mince the lemongrass, garlic and shallots.
Marinate the chicken with them, fish sauce and sugar for 30 minutes.
Cook in a hot pan or grill until caramelized and cooked through.
Serve with rice.

name: Ca Kho To (Caramelized Clay Pot Fish)
steps: Cook sugar in a pot until it turns a deep amber caramel.
Add shallots and garlic, then the fish sauce and coconut water.
Add the fish steaks and simmer for 25 minutes, turning once, until the sauce is thick.
Top with green onion and plenty of black pepper.

name: Bo Luc Lac (Shaking Beef)
steps: Marinate cubed beef in soy sauce, oyster sauce, garlic and sugar for 20 minutes.
Sear in a very hot pan, shaking the pan, for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add sliced red onion for the last 30 seconds.
Serve over watercress and tomato with a lime, salt and pepper dip.

name: Dau Sot Ca Chua (Tofu in Tomato Sauce)
steps: Fry cubes of tofu until golden on all sides.
Cook garlic, then add chopped tomato and cook until saucy.
Season with soy sauce and a little sugar.
Add the tofu, simmer for 5 minutes, and top with green onion.

name: Bun Chay (Tofu Vermicelli Bowl)
steps: Fry cubed tofu until crisp.
Cook the vermicelli and rinse in cold water.
Mix soy sauce, lime juice, sugar, garlic and water for the dressing.
Build bowls of noodles, lettuce, cucumber, carrot, mint and tofu, then top with peanuts and dressing.

name: Canh Chua (Sour Fish Soup)
steps: Fry garlic, then add 5 cups of water and the tamarind paste and bring to a boil.
Add pineapple, tomato and okra and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the fish and simmer gently until cooked.
Season with fish sauce and sugar, then add the bean sprouts just before serving.

name: Com Tam with Grilled Pork Chops
steps: Pound thin pork chops and marinate with lemongrass, garlic, shallots, fish sauce and sugar.
Grill or pan-fry until caramelized and cooked.
Serve over rice with sliced cucumber and tomato.
Spoon a little sweetened fish sauce over the top.

name: Coq au Vin
steps: Crisp the bacon, then brown the chicken pieces in the fat.
Add the carrot, onions and garlic, then sprinkle in the flour.
Pour in the red wine, add thyme and simmer covered for 1 hour.
Brown the mushrooms in butter and add them for the last 15 minutes.

name: Beef Bourguignon
steps: Brown the bacon, then sear the beef cubes in batches.
Cook the carrot and garlic, stir in the tomato paste and flour.
Add the wine, broth, thyme and beef, then cover and cook at 160°C (325°F) for 2.5 hours.
Brown the mushrooms and onions and stir them in for the last 30 minutes.

name: Ratatouille
steps: Cook the onion and bell pepper in olive oil until soft.
Brown the eggplant and zucchini separately.
Combine with garlic, chopped tomato and thyme.
Simmer gently for 30 minutes until rich and tender.

name: French Onion Soup
steps: Cook thinly sliced onions in butter over low heat for 40 minutes until deep brown.
Add the wine and let it reduce, then add the broth and thyme and simmer for 20 minutes.
Ladle into ovenproof bowls and top with toasted baguette slices and grated gruyère.
Broil until bubbling and golden.

name: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Blind-bake the crust at 190°C (375°F) for 15 minutes.
Crisp the bacon and scatter it over the crust with grated gruyère.
Whisk the eggs and cream with salt, pepper and nutmeg and pour over.
Bake at 170°C (340°F) for 30 to 35 minutes until just set.

name: Croque Monsieur
steps: Make a white sauce: cook butter and flour, then whisk in milk until thick.
Spread bread with mustard and fill with ham and gruyère.
Top with the sauce and more gruyère.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 10 minutes, then broil until golden.

name: Salade Niçoise
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender and blanch the green beans.
Hard-boil the eggs and quarter them.
Whisk mustard, red wine vinegar and olive oil for the dressing.
Arrange everything over the lettuce and drizzle with the dressing.

name: Sole Meunière
steps: Season the fish and dust lightly with flour.
Cook in butter for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden, then plate.
Add more butter to the pan and cook until nutty brown.
Add lemon juice and parsley and pour over the fish.

name: Poulet à la Moutarde (Mustard Chicken)
steps: Brown the chicken skin-side down, then flip and set aside.
Cook the shallots and garlic, then add the white wine and reduce.
Stir in the cream, mustard and thyme.
Return the chicken and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked through.

name: French Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with salt until smooth.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat and add the eggs.
Stir quickly while shaking the pan until softly set.
Roll the omelette onto a plate and top with chives.

name: Crêpes
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, melted butter and a pinch of salt until smooth, then rest for 15 minutes.
Pour a thin layer into a hot buttered pan and swirl.
Cook for 1 minute, flip, and cook for 30 seconds more.
Fill with anything sweet or savory.

name: Puy Lentil Salad
steps: Simmer the lentils with thyme for 20 to 25 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Whisk mustard, red wine vinegar and olive oil.
Toss the warm lentils with the dressing, diced carrot and shallots.
Finish with parsley.

name: Seafood Paella
steps: Cook the onion, bell pepper and garlic in olive oil, then add grated tomato and paprika.
Stir in the rice, then add hot stock with saffron.
Simmer without stirring for 15 minutes.
Add the shrimp and peas on top and cook for 5 more minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

name: Spanish Tortilla
steps: Slowly cook thinly sliced potatoes and onion in plenty of olive oil until soft, then drain.
Mix with beaten eggs and salt.
Cook in a pan over low heat until mostly set.
Flip onto a plate, slide back in, and cook the other side for 2 to 3 minutes.

name: Gazpacho
steps: Roughly chop the vegetables.
Blend with garlic, sherry vinegar, olive oil and salt until smooth.
Chill for at least 1 hour.
Serve cold with a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Gambas al Ajillo (Garlic Shrimp)
steps: Gently heat plenty of olive oil with sliced garlic and chili flakes.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until pink.
Season with salt and finish with parsley.

name: Patatas Bravas
steps: Cube the potatoes and roast at 220°C (425°F) for 35 minutes until crisp.
Cook onion and garlic, then add smoked paprika, chili flakes and chopped tomato.
Simmer for 10 minutes and blend into a smooth sauce.
Spoon the sauce over the potatoes.

name: Pollo al Ajillo (Garlic Chicken)
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in olive oil.
Add whole garlic cloves, bay leaves and thyme.
Pour in the white wine, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Uncover, reduce the sauce, and finish with parsley.

name: Chorizo and Chickpea Stew
steps: Fry the sliced chorizo until it releases its oil.
Add onion and garlic and cook until soft.
Add smoked paprika, chopped tomato and chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.

name: Albóndigas (Spanish Meatballs)
steps: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, parsley and salt, then roll into small balls.
Brown the meatballs and set aside.
Cook onion, then add white wine, smoked paprika and chopped tomato and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the meatballs and simmer for 20 minutes.

name: Pisto with Eggs
steps: Slowly cook the onion and bell pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add the eggplant and zucchini and cook until tender.
Add garlic and chopped tomato and simmer for 15 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, and cook covered until set.

name: Espinacas con Garbanzos
steps: Fry the garlic in olive oil, then add cumin and smoked paprika.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted.
Add the chickpeas and a splash of water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with sherry vinegar and salt.

name: Pan con Tomate
steps: Toast thick slices of bread.
Rub them with a cut garlic clove.
Grate ripe tomato and spread it over the bread.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.

name: Merluza en Salsa Verde (Hake in Green Sauce)
steps: Gently cook the garlic in olive oil, then stir in the flour.
Add the white wine and stock gradually, stirring, to make a light sauce.
Add the fish and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes, shaking the pan.
Finish with plenty of chopped parsley.
